description: EXPERIMENTAL: written from Prometheus' documented HTTP API and tested against recorded and mock responses, not yet against a real Prometheus, so it may not work as is. Reads metrics (range and instant PromQL queries) and the alerts that are firing, read-only. Works with Prometheus and with the long-term stores that speak its API (Mimir, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics). Off until an environment sets it up.

baseUrl.description: The Prometheus (or Mimir, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics) URL, e.g. http://prometheus.internal:9090; a path prefix is kept

authorization.description: The whole Authorization header, if it needs one: 'Bearer <token>' or 'Basic <base64>'

orgId.description: The tenant, sent as X-Scope-OrgID, for Mimir or Cortex

queryRange.description: A PromQL query over a time range, as points with their times (thinned to about 50 per series), e.g. payment_confirm_queue_depth{env="prod"} or rate(http_requests_total[5m]). Read-only. Experimental: not verified against a live Prometheus.

from.description: Start: ISO 8601 or relative like now-1h (default now-1h)

query.description: A PromQL query at one instant: the current value of a metric, or of an expression like sum(rate(errors_total[5m])). Read-only. Experimental: not verified against a live Prometheus.

at.description: The instant: ISO 8601 or relative (default now)

alerts.description: The alerts Prometheus is evaluating, with their state (firing or pending), labels and when they became active: what is alerting. Read-only. Experimental: not verified against a live Prometheus.
